theorems.name: Submission.arp_rgr_right_inverse_contDiffOn
theorems.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (Φ X : Rn n → Rn n) (U W : Set (Rn n)) (κ : ℝ), IsOpen U → IsOpen W → 0 < κ → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Φ U → (∀ x ∈ U, ∀ h : Rn n, κ * ‖h‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ Φ x h‖) → ContinuousOn X W → (∀ w ∈ W, X w ∈ U ∧ Φ (X w) = w) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 X W ∧ ∀ w ∈ W, ‖fderiv ℝ X w‖ ≤ κ⁻¹
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
